title: Direct OCI Generative AI preview
changes: Use direct OCI Generative AI for separate design and review, with configurable models and instance-principal authentication.
Retain genuine provider and request evidence alongside source approvals, deterministic rendering and SQLcl checks.
Keep OPAF available as an optional compatible provider.
Package the built UI and offline dependencies for an isolated preview.
limitations: Preview acceptance is in progress; source changes do not establish hosted conversion or runtime success.
Only explicitly approved redacted source may be processed by the selected provider.
Generated APEX, technical verification and human business acceptance remain separate facts.
Oracle Forms, Java, SQLcl, an authorized compatible target and runtime browser prerequisites are external dependencies.
Partial prototypes explicitly omit unsupported behavior and use synthetic data. Uncertain imports require reconciliation and are never automatically repeated.
